canonical_reference.required_identity_meaning: independent digital educational, research and authorial platform

review_scope: faithful meaning against Macedonian and English canonical references
WPA terminology consistency: protocole, diplomatie, communication publique, études de sécurité, Protocolometry, communicologie
institutional wording must not imply university, state academy, accreditation body or degree-granting status
draft disclosures and canonical-language notices must remain clear
titles, descriptions, navigation labels, cards and footer must be reviewed
accessibility and responsive presentation must be reviewed on the final candidate
immutability_rule: If either reviewed French HTML blob changes after human review, the human linguistic, terminology, institutional/legal and accessibility review evidence must be revalidated against the new candidate before activation.
activation_rule: This package cannot activate French. A later dedicated activation PR may proceed only after human review evidence is complete, candidate provenance is validated, post-review technical checks pass and explicit Human Gate approval is recorded.
